brands.description: Every brand the answer names, in the order they first appear. Empty when none.

name.description: The brand exactly as written in the answer, without added legal suffixes.

domain.description: The brand's website domain only if the answer states it (e.g. example.ch), else null.

sentiment.description: How the answer speaks about this brand.

recommended.description: True only if the answer recommends or suggests choosing this brand.

evidence.description: A short quote copied verbatim from the answer (at most 200 characters) that mentions the brand.
